population.kidComparison: About 20.8 million people live in Kazakhstan—roughly the population of a major world region.

geography.climate: Temperate four-season climate with warm summers and cool to cold winters.
geography.terrain: Inland terrain bordered by neighboring countries.

anthem.title: National Anthem of Kazakhstan
anthem.summary: The official patriotic anthem played at national ceremonies in Kazakhstan.

exploration.didYouKnow: Kazakhstan is located in Central Asia and its capital city is Astana.
